questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

I _ _ Q Z _ _ K _ _ I J _ Q Z
questions.solution:
Given :- I _ _ Q Z _ _ K _ _ I J _ Q Z

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) IJKQZQK → I **I J** Q Z - **K Q** K **Z Q** - I J **K** Q Z

2) IQZIJKI → I **I Q** Q Z - **Z I** K **J K** - I J **I** Q Z

3) JKIJQZK → I **J K **Q Z - **I J** K **Q Z** - I J **K** Q Z

 
• Here, **"IJKQZ"** is repeated.

4) JKQQZKI → I **J K **Q Z - **Q Q** K **Z K** - I J **I** Q Z

 
• Option (3) gives the pattern of :- I J K Q Z - I J K Q Z - I J K Q Z

Hence, the correct answer is **"JKIJQZK".**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some bags are pens.

All pens are boxes.

All bags are books.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some books are boxes.

II. Some boxes are bags.

Ill. Some books are pens.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow
All conclusions I, II and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4c3201c01327ecbb9b7c3af36bcb7effc98fdcdc4ff6e3a5a09aa4cb5ca6bc5.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some books are boxes → True (As Some bags are pens and All bags are books and All pens are boxes so, Some books are boxes is true)

II. Some boxes are bags → True (As Some bags are pens and All pens are boxes so, Some boxes are bags is true)

Ill. Some books are pens → True (As Some bags are pens and All bags are books so, Some books are pens is true)

∴ Here, Conclusions I, II and III are true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"All conclusions I, II and III follow".**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the sixth number is related to the fifth number.

23 : 368 :: 25 : ? :: 21 : 294
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

**First number × (First number - 7) = Second number**

1) 23 : 368 → 23 × (23 - 7) = 23 × 16 = 368

And,

**2) 25 : ? → 25 × (25 - 7) = 25 × 18 = 450**

Similarly,

3) 21 : 294 → 21 × (21 - 7) = 21 × 14 = 294

Hence, the correct answer is **"450".**

questions.question: If the ratio of the present ages of Shikha and Rajkumar is 2 ∶ 1, and 15 years ago the ratio of their ages was 3 ∶ 1, then the present age (in years) of Shikha is:
questions.solution:
Given, Ratio of present ages of Shikha and Rajkumar = 2 :1

Let us consider present ages of Shikha and Rajkumar = 2x : x

15 years ago the ratio of their ages was = 3 ∶ 1

Hence,

(2x - 15) / (x - 15) = 3 / 1

2x - 15 = 3(x - 15)

2x - 15 = 3x - 45

3x - 2x = 45 - 15

∴ x = 30

Thus, the present age of Shikha = 2x = 2 × 30 = 60 years

Hence, the correct answer is **"60".**

questions.question:
If 'P' denotes 'addition', 'Q' denotes 'multiplication', 'R' denotes 'subtraction', and 'S' denotes 'division', then what will be the value of the following expression?

45 S (3P7) P5S (8S4) P9Q (15S5)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b968da625e3936f9364a60f4ec3bdc8f1d4b1d1db9850270d1f3b4f0822dfd51.png] 

'P' denotes 'addition', 'Q' denotes 'multiplication', 'R' denotes 'subtraction', and 'S' denotes 'division'.

 
 

 **Alphabet**
 P
 Q
 R
 S
 
 

 **Symbol**
 +
 × 
 -
 ÷ 
 
 

Given equation : 45 S (3P7) P5S (8S4) P9Q (15S5)

After replacing the symbols instead of alphabets in given equation is as follows : 45 ÷ (3 + 7) + 5 ÷ (8 ÷ 4) + 9 × (15 ÷ 5)

= 45 ÷ __**(3 + 7)**__ + 5 ÷ __**(8 ÷ 4)**__ + 9 × __**(15 ÷ 5)**__

= __**45 ÷ 10**__ + __**5 ÷ 2**__ + 9 × 3

= 4.5 + 2.5 + __**9 × 3**__

= __**4.5 + 2.5**__ + 27

= __**7 + 27**__

**= 34**

Hence, the correct answer is **"34".**
